name: Brick wall
summary: Brick wall segment with staggered bricks and a coping cap, 1000 px wide so it tiles; for streets, gardens and yards.

params.name: x
params.note: centre x of this segment; place copies at x ± 1000 to tile

params.name: y
params.note: floor line: the plinth stands on y

params.name: s
params.note: about 1040 px wide and 480 px tall at s = 1 (1000 px of wall between the caps)

params.name: anim
params.note: lights = small wall lights along the coping glow one after another; pop = scales in
